name: Should I repair or replace my old gate?

mainEntity.name: Should I repair or replace my old gate?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to repair or replace your gate depends on several factors, including the age of the gate, the extent and frequency of repairs, and the cost-effectiveness of each option. If the gate is old, frequently breaking down, or the repair cost approaches that of a new installation, replacement might be a more economical long-term solution. Conversely, minor damage on a relatively new gate often warrants repair. Frasheski Construction can help clients in Oakland and El Cerrito evaluate the condition of their existing gate and provide a recommendation based on their specific situation and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Decide to repair or replace based on gate age, repair frequency, and cost-effectiveness. New, minor issues favor repair; extensive, frequent problems suggest replacement.
